question: Which of the following states holds the first rank in female literacy as per the 2011 census?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Kerala.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As per the Census 2022, **Kerala** holds the first rank in female Literacy Rate.
 
• **Lakshwadeep **has the Highest Male Literacy Rate as per the **Census 2011.**
 
• The literacy rate in the country is **74.04%, 82.14%** for males, and **65.46 for females**.
 
• The lowest female literacy is in **Rajasthan with a rate of 52.66%.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

• As per the Census 2011, the population of Uttar Pradesh is the Highest Population in **India.**
